text.zh_cn:
苔藓覆盖之处，必有幽暗。
- 深暗之域中，苔藓块与 [block:minecraft:sculk_sensor] 相伴
- 潜行前行，避免惊动 [entity:minecraft:warden]
- [item:minecraft:glow_berries] 照亮无声的洞穴
> 嘘——黑暗在听。
text.en_us:
Where moss grows, darkness follows.
- In the deep dark, moss sits beside [block:minecraft:sculk_sensor]
- Sneak, lest you wake [entity:minecraft:warden]
- [item:minecraft:glow_berries] light the silent caves
> Shh — the dark is listening.
